name: The Pool
hours: Lane swimming in the Morning, open swim Midday to Evening; lifeguard on duty (often Sunny Aldane). Closed at night. Pool safety in the Afternoon: Baraka Otieno.
sight: A fifty-metre outdoor pool of hard blue water set into a terrace above the sea, ringed with white loungers and a rank of flags that snap in the trade wind. The lane ropes are in dorm colours. Light wobbles on the underside of the changing-room awning, and the tannoy plays whatever the lifeguard likes. It smells of chlorine and sunscreen and hot concrete.
things: Swim lengths (fitness; clears the head before study)
Lounge and people-watch — the whole school passes through in a week
Race someone for a stake and lose to anyone from the swim squad
Play 'float duel' on the foam mat with waterproof proxy cards
Climb the lifeguard chair when invited and see the pool from Sunny's seat
Join the Wednesday swim meet as a competitor or a timekeeper
Take a paid shift as assistant lifeguard (needs the swim test)
Dive for the brass token someone always throws into the deep end
secret: Sunny's territory and route start; job site (assistant lifeguard, needs swim test). Swim meet Day 17. The pool is the casual meeting place across dorm lines; Jessica holds court on the loungers on Saturday middays, Ashton prowls.
